title: Use the Zone Config Aveva API page to update lane zone settings
summary: A support user can use the Zone Config Aveva API page’s “Update Zone Configuration” function to modify zone settings for lanes, so operations can adapt based on system needs or changing requirements.
when_to_use: Use when you need to modify lane zone settings using the Zone Config Aveva API page’s “Update Zone Configuration” function so the system’s lane configuration can adapt to system needs or changing requirements.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the zone configuration update using the Zone Config Aveva API page and confirm the updated lane zone settings are reflected on-screen.
access_or_tools_needed: Zone Config Aveva API page interface
Editable lane zone settings fields/controls on that page
